notes: EDO0524 (letter 20/2014: first period 4.00%, margin 1.50% from period 2, fee 2.00) rebuilt from the same structure as the EDO1036 manifest; it is not in the catalog. The letter allows an early request until one month before maturity; the fixture states 30 days. The interest table is the Ministry's PDF of 2023-04-18; its values are the accrued interest of one bond bought on the first sale day.

cases.description: official example: bought 2014-05-10 at 4.00%, period 2 at 1.50%, early redemption requested 2015-06-09, interest accrued to 2015-06-16 is 4.16, fee 2.00, payout before tax 100 + 4.16 - 2 = 102.16 (101.75 after 0.41 tax)
same lot and day as the official example, period 2 rate derived from GUS CPI of 2015-03 (-1.50%, floored to 0) + 1.50% margin = 1.50%, the rate the page states
